readerCopy.body: The responsibility keeping everything together may also be the responsibility making it impossible to change. When Saturn squares the North Node, a job, contract, caregiving role, debt, deadline, or obligation can take up enough time and authority that the choice you need to make keeps getting deferred. The responsibility may be legitimate, but simply carrying more will not solve a conflict built into the setup. Put the cost on paper and decide what has to be renegotiated, delegated, completed, or ended before duty becomes the reason nothing else can move.
